name: bc_s831683_mpnn8_S15D
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. Single Ser->Asp installed at position 15 on the best-binding BindCraft backbone (d3acid_l65_s831683). Matched wild-type, same batch, same gate: 3.15x -> 5.46x. Predicted affinity 0.821->0.776 human / 0.807->0.764 mouse, i.e. the switch is installed at a small affinity cost, not free. Switching residue is the TARGET's own H433 (native domain III, conserved in mouse) -- not an affinity tag. pH = median over 5 ESMFold2 refold poses. 5.46x is 98% of H433's single-site thermodynamic ceiling (5.55x), so ranks 1-4 span 0.22 pKa units and are NOT distinguishable from one another.

name: rimA02_d3_rimA_14_vhh
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE. VHH format: antibody-rule Level 3 (CDRH3 13.6%, global 84.8%, source analysis/01-egfr/novelty_ANTIBODY.tsv). pH 5.19x, median over 6 refold poses, switching on the target's native H433. AFFINITY INADEQUATELY ASSESSED, NOT LOW: this instrument scores a real 5 nM VHH at 0.0000 with 5/5 dead seeds, and scores four framework-preserving CDR decoys on that same VHH scaffold at 0.0000 too -- it cannot separate a validated nanobody from a randomised-CDR decoy. The 0.228/0.451 columns are reported for completeness and should not be read as weak binding.

name: d2c_mpnn13_S88D_serasp
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. The project's causal result on a second, unrelated backbone: parent wild-type 0.70x (no switch) -> single Ser88->Asp 4.57x -> truncating that Asp back to Ala in the same coordinates 0.72x. Knockout effect +5.20 pKa units, the largest measured here. pH = median over 5 refold poses; target's native H433. Predicted affinity 0.603 human / 0.528 mouse.

name: bc_d3acid_l65_s831683_mpnn11
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. Unmutated ProteinMPNN sequence on the same d3acid_l65_s831683 backbone as ranks 1-4 and 9, carrying a native Asp at the equivalent position. pH 4.01x as the median over 6 refold poses; target's native H433. Predicted affinity 0.796 human / 0.784 mouse -- among the highest in the pool. No cysteine. Six of these ten rows share this backbone: that is a deliberate trade of panel diversity for wet-lab replication of the only causal result we have.

name: bc_s831683_mpnn9_WT
assessment: MATCHED WILD-TYPE CONTROL, submitted on purpose and not as a candidate. Identical to rank 3 except position 15 (Ser vs Asp). It reads 3.52x as the median over 11 refold poses against rank 3's 5.43x. If rank 3 switches and this does not, the Ser->Asp mechanism is established in the laboratory independently of every threshold in our methods document; if both switch equally, the mutation is not the cause and that is equally informative. Predicted affinity 0.783 human / 0.783 mouse.

name: h370_020_vhh
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE. VHH format: antibody-rule Level 4 (CDRH3 27.3%, global 52.6%) -- the only de novo design in this set under that rule. Note it is Level 2 under the general-protein rule (TM 0.914), so its eligibility depends on being classified as an antibody. CDR3 AAVDDETGDIY is carboxylate-rich and pairs with the target's native H433. pH 2.29x pooled over 11 refold poses in two independent arms. AFFINITY INADEQUATELY ASSESSED -- VHH format, see rank 5.
